description:
List repositories accessible via a VCS integration (connected GitHub account).

Use this only for integrations whose `vcs_account_name` matches the GitHub repository owner. Compare each repository's `source_url` with the requested URL after stripping a trailing `.git` and lowercasing both.

The tool follows pagination until there are no more pages, or until 1000 repositories have been collected (whichever comes first). If truncated, `truncated` is true and `next` may still be set when more pages exist.

Returns `remote_repository_id`, `full_name`, `source_url`, and `default_branch_name` for each repository. If no repository matches, follow the trusted no-match guidance returned before the untrusted API data.

organization_id.description: Organization ID returned by aiven_vcs_integration_list. Use that tool first to obtain this value.

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of why you are making this call. Used for audit logs and debugging. Do NOT include any PII or secrets (emails, names, credentials, tokens, connection URIs, IPs, or customer/project identifiers); describe intent only. Max 2000 characters.

vcs_integration_id.description: VCS integration ID returned by aiven_vcs_integration_list (e.g. "vcs-abc123").

name: aiven_vcs_integration_repository_list
title: List VCS Integration Repositories
